MS Ms Alison Goody
Community Occupational Therapist
Northwood Community Health Centre
Northwood


17/6/2018
Re: Ms Betty Weston
Dear Ms Goody,
I am writing to refer Ms Betty Weston, a 59-year-old divorced lady who was diagnosed with
carpal tunnel syndrome and requires your an assessment for her a wrist splint.                       Commented [PQ1]: Good purpose
Ms wWeston initially presented to my clinic on 10/6/2018 with signs and symptoms indicative of
carpel tunnel syndrome in her right hand, such as: numbness, tingling and pain. for                  Commented [PQ2]: Good paragraph
which, paracetamol was prescribed.
On review after one week, Ms Weston reported feeling fatigue and complained of cold
intolerance along with constipation. Therefore, conservative management was recommended
including a night time wrist splint for at least 3 weeks and further investigations (EMG, NCS)       Commented [PQ3]: Good paragraph
and tests (TSH) were requested to exclude any other neurological diagnoses and thyroid
issues.
As well as, sShe was advised to reduce her weight , was and referred to physical therapy to          Commented [PQ4]: Avoid “as well as” ( too informal)
provide her with an aerobic fitness and weight loss program for her wrist. Please note that Ms
Weston has a medical history of diabetes, obesity, arthrosis and hypothyroidism
hypothyriodism.                                                                                      Commented [PQ5]: Take care wit spelling
Based on the above, It would appreciated if you could provide her with an ergonomics
aergonomics assessment and the a right wrist splint in a neutral position. Should you require
further information, do not hesitate to contact me.
Yours sincerely,
Dr M
